title: Ruth Valentine, Miller Maits and Jean Snowden — remembering Bethel
subtitle: Bethel Presbyterian Church, Historical Room — a session with three of the oldest members, 25 September 1983
date_source: Filename, not a slate. The source JSON records the date as user-supplied by John Decker, written '9-25-83' on the original capture (field recorded.source); the tape states no date of its own. One internal detail agrees: the moderator closes with 'over 200 years now of history, almost 206 or 207 years, I guess, this year', and Bethel was founded on 5 November 1776, which gives 1982 or 1983.

provenance.collection: Bethel Presbyterian Church — Historical Room oral histories
provenance.capture_notes: One session capture, ALAC 48 kHz stereo 16-bit, 1,559.979 s, 58,020,991 bytes, md5 913bdf2b51aa75586d7cd6931b03403f (recomputed here and identical to the md5 in the source JSON). No per-item digitisation date is recorded in the source JSON; 2026-10-18 is the collection's digitisation date per the archive README and folder, and the master's NAS mtime is 2026-10-19 23:22 EDT. The master is the capture as received; the transcription working copy was a 2:1 channel sum with +3.78 dB of gain, and that processed copy was not kept. The last ~1 m 40 s is post-meeting chatter away from the microphone.

speakers.label: RUTH VALENTINE
speakers.name: Ruth Valentine (née Douglas)
speakers.note: Born 26 December 1913, per the cradle-roll certificate she reads aloud (enrolled 28 March 1914). 'Ruth' is spoken by the moderator at the hand-over; 'Valentine' is from the filename only and is a married name.

speakers.label: MILLER MAITS
speakers.name: Miller Maits
speakers.note: A descendant of the Oliver Miller family, named twice on the tape — by the moderator ('The next person is Miller Maits') and by Ruth. The only one of the three surnames the tape says aloud.

speakers.label: JEAN SNOWDEN
speakers.name: Jean Snowden
speakers.note: 'Jean' is spoken by the moderator at the hand-over ('Jean, why don't you take over'); 'Snowden' is from the filename only and is not on the tape. The ASR renders the name both 'Jean' and 'Gene'.

speakers.label: HOST
speakers.name: unidentified moderator
speakers.note: Unnamed man who introduces each speaker, reads the church's history and speaks for about a third of the tape. Never names himself; not one of the three participants (median f0 150 Hz against 206, 113 and 208 Hz).

speakers.label: UNIDENTIFIED
speakers.name: unidentified voices
speakers.note: After 24:20 only: the meeting breaks up and the off-microphone chatter cannot be attributed. Includes the 'quarter to 11' exchange.
